title: Muscle Mass Falls To 65 Percent By Age 80
hook: Muscle loss accelerates late, but training changed the study pattern.
closing: The study shows later muscle loss can accelerate, while resistance training can still change the outcome.
question: How often do you strength train?

segments.say: Muscle mass fell to 65 percent, leaving much less reserve for everyday strength.
The later muscle-loss rate reached 18 percent per decade, showing the decline accelerated.
Measured sarcopenia fell to 0 percent after resistance training, so decline was not irreversible in this study.
